metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the shop before church, the gap in the pew, Joan at the lane, and the wheel.

yesterday: Your father stayed home. He blamed a fairy and shut his own door.
You counted the pew. Mother, Anne, three children, Joan, two brothers. One gap.
Joan told you to walk to Anne yourself. The disagreement stays between the two of you.
The wheel turns. It turns unevenly. The line on the tables is written.
